phase: Within-domain feature and residual regression with reference-zero inference
mechanism: Weighted within-domain projection H removes domain averages from both source features and residual target. Ridge fits HZ to Hy without intercept. RBF fits centered feature-space kernel HKH^T to Hy. Inference returns f(current)-f(first10-reference); no target-domain mean is estimated.
selection: B123 validation domain-equal MAE chooses shared key/gain across8parents, original tie rules, all21 choices frozen before scoring
control: Constant is exact identity. Same-key/gain anchored residual control isolates within-domain fitting; same-key/gain centered-target and plain controls if promising. Source budget unchanged.
acceptance: Original all3dataset all3metric independent,incremental and16group complementarity,paired intervals and risk stability requirements unchanged
limits: Shared within-domain relation and reference-zero error are hypotheses, not established physics
No test-domain truth or inference domain ID is used
Weighted centering/kernel ridge are standard methods, not claimed novel
Inherited parent configurations and repeatedly exposed development cohorts; not independent confirmation
Reference normalization may remove real offsets; CALCE excluded; M1-M3 unchanged
